{"task": "vLLM Sleep Mode level 1 和 level 2 对 weights、KV cache 的处理有什么不同？", "evidence": [{"id": "E9d07846dbc1ae1b8d4fbaa19", "chunk_id": "d4addd34fafa7cc7adcc46da", "parent_id": "61ca270d637f7077753f21a1", "source": "/Users/jennyma/Projects/InfraAgent/evals/agent-e2e-v1/corpus/vllm-sleep_mode.md", "sha256": "f0316decf7985681413ca5ece1a238725da31e38c6ad228f5461a211e1833b60", "locator": "/Users/jennyma/Projects/InfraAgent/evals/agent-e2e-v1/corpus/vllm-sleep_mode.md#L18-L18", "content": "Level 1 sleep will offload the model weights and discard the KV cache.
The content of KV cache is forgotten.
Level 1 sleep is good for sleeping and waking up the engine to run the same model again.
The model weights are backed up in CPU memory.
Please make sure there's enough CPU memory to store the model weights.", "truncated": false, "metadata": {"release": "v0.10.2", "commit": "01efc7ef781391e744ed08c3292817a773d654e6", "source_type": "documentation"}}, {"id": "Eb5c5286bf7723eb1f7a34287", "chunk_id": "0361a5fbcf40ef5bf88af6ec", "parent_id": "61ca270d637f7077753f21a1", "source": "/Users/jennyma/Projects/InfraAgent/evals/agent-e2e-v1/corpus/vllm-sleep_mode.md", "sha256": "f0316decf7985681413ca5ece1a238725da31e38c6ad228f5461a211e1833b60", "locator": "/Users/jennyma/Projects/InfraAgent/evals/agent-e2e-v1/corpus/vllm-sleep_mode.md#L18-L18", "content": "Level 2 sleep will discard both the model weights and the KV cache (while the model's buffers are kept in CPU, like rope scaling tensors).
The content of both the model weights and KV cache is forgotten.
Level 2 sleep is good for sleeping and waking up the engine to run a different model or update the model, where previous model weights are not needed, e.g.
RLHF weight update.", "truncated": false, "metadata": {"release": "v0.10.2", "commit": "01efc7ef781391e744ed08c3292817a773d654e6", "source_type": "documentation"}}, {"id": "E6f352f27a9a752b7ddda2b69", "chunk_id": "5b467b156fda2408bc8abfcb", "parent_id": "945da38f9869ed99eb465a09", "source": "/Users/jennyma/Projects/InfraAgent/evals/agent-e2e-v1/corpus/vllm-sleep_mode.md", "sha256": "f0316decf7985681413ca5ece1a238725da31e38c6ad228f5461a211e1833b60", "locator": "/Users/jennyma/Projects/InfraAgent/evals/agent-e2e-v1/corpus/vllm-sleep_mode.md#L33-L39", "content": "```python
# Put the engine to sleep (level=1: offload weights to CPU RAM, discard KV cache)
llm.sleep(level=1)

# Wake up the engine (restore weights)
llm.wake_up()
```", "truncated": false, "metadata": {"release": "v0.10.2", "commit": "01efc7ef781391e744ed08c3292817a773d654e6", "source_type": "documentation"}}, {"id": "Ed2911e94060a37799d8e5446", "chunk_id": "249f890f1805949626db6e1b", "parent_id": "d66b2cd8eec325d1558fabee", "source": "/Users/jennyma/Projects/InfraAgent/evals/agent-e2e-v1/corpus/vllm-sleep_mode.md", "sha256": "f0316decf7985681413ca5ece1a238725da31e38c6ad228f5461a211e1833b60", "locator": "/Users/jennyma/Projects/InfraAgent/evals/agent-e2e-v1/corpus/vllm-sleep_mode.md#L7-L11", "content": "- **Frees GPU memory**: Offloads model weights to CPU RAM and discards KV cache, releasing up to 90%+ of GPU memory for other tasks.
- **Fast resume**: Quickly wake up the engine and resume inference without full model reload.
- **API endpoints**: Control sleep/wake_up state via HTTP endpoints or Python API.
- **Supports distributed workloads**: Works with tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, etc.", "truncated": false, "metadata": {"release": "v0.10.2", "commit": "01efc7ef781391e744ed08c3292817a773d654e6", "source_type": "documentation"}}, {"id": "Efbdf670dbe060d708ee523e7", "chunk_id": "09c2e6a85e258a6450cf43e1", "parent_id": "bbe54b1cb37f224150fb3031", "source": "/Users/jennyma/Projects/InfraAgent/evals/agent-e2e-v1/corpus/vllm-sleep_mode.md", "sha256": "f0316decf7985681413ca5ece1a238725da31e38c6ad228f5461a211e1833b60", "locator": "/Users/jennyma/Projects/InfraAgent/evals/agent-e2e-v1/corpus/vllm-sleep_mode.md#L3-L3", "content": "vLLM's Sleep Mode allows you to temporarily release most GPU memory used by a model, including model weights and KV cache, without stopping the server or unloading the Docker container. This is especially useful for RLHF, training, or cost-saving scenarios where GPU resources need to be freed between inference workloads.", "truncated": false, "metadata": {"release": "v0.10.2", "commit": "01efc7ef781391e744ed08c3292817a773d654e6", "source_type": "documentation"}}, {"id": "E4d3c6bf2ad0b60a0eb6d3265", "chunk_id": "c6a72f8e94186c6eb7d237d4", "parent_id": "d66b2cd8eec325d1558fabee", "source": "/Users/jennyma/Projects/InfraAgent/evals/agent-e2e-v1/corpus/vllm-sleep_mode.md", "sha256": "f0316decf7985681413ca5ece1a238725da31e38c6ad228f5461a211e1833b60", "locator": "/Users/jennyma/Projects/InfraAgent/evals/agent-e2e-v1/corpus/vllm-sleep_mode.md#L7-L11", "content": "- **Fine-grained control**: Optionally wake up only model weights or KV cache to avoid OOM during weight updates.", "truncated": false, "metadata": {"release": "v0.10.2", "commit": "01efc7ef781391e744ed08c3292817a773d654e6", "source_type": "documentation"}}], "registered_parents": ["61ca270d637f7077753f21a1", "945da38f9869ed99eb465a09", "bbe54b1cb37f224150fb3031", "d66b2cd8eec325d1558fabee"], "previous_error": null, "final_only": false, "remaining_tool_calls": 3}

{"action":"final","status":"answered","answer":"vLLM Sleep Mode 的两个级别对 weights 和 KV cache 的处理不同（文档版本 v0.10.2）：

- Level 1：将 model weights 卸载（offload）到 CPU 内存，并丢弃（discard）KV cache；KV cache 的内容被遗忘。模型权重备份在 CPU 内存中，因此需要确保有足够的 CPU 内存来存放模型权重。适用于让引擎休眠后再唤醒以运行同一个模型。[E9d07846dbc1ae1b8d4fbaa19]
- Level 2：同时丢弃 model weights 和 KV cache（模型的 buffers 保留在 CPU，例如 rope scaling tensors）；模型权重和 KV cache 的内容都被遗忘。适用于休眠后唤醒以运行不同模型或更新模型（例如 RLHF 权重更新），此时不需要之前的模型权重。[Eb5c5286bf7723eb1f7a34287]

补充：Level 1 的 Python API 用法为 llm.sleep(level=1)（注释说明：offload weights to CPU RAM, discard KV cache），唤醒用 llm.wake_up() 恢复权重。[E6f352f27a9a752b7ddda2b69]","claims":[{"id":"c1","text":"Level 1 sleep 将 model weights 卸载到 CPU 内存，并丢弃 KV cache，KV cache 内容被遗忘。","evidence_ids":["E9d07846dbc1ae1b8d4fbaa19"]},{"id":"c2","text":"Level 1 sleep 的模型权重备份在 CPU 内存中，需要确保有足够的 CPU 内存来存放模型权重。","evidence_ids":["E9d07846dbc1ae1b8d4fbaa19"]},{"id":"c3","text":"Level 2 sleep 同时丢弃 model weights 和 KV cache，模型权重与 KV cache 的内容都被遗忘。","evidence_ids":["Eb5c5286bf7723eb1f7a34287"]},{"id":"c4","text":"Level 2 sleep 时模型的 buffers 保留在 CPU（例如 rope scaling tensors）。","evidence_ids":["Eb5c5286bf7723eb1f7a34287"]},{"id":"c5","text":"Level 1 的 Python API 为 llm.sleep(level=1)，注释说明其 offload weights to CPU RAM 并 discard KV cache；唤醒用 llm.wake_up() 恢复权重。","evidence_ids":["E6f352f27a9a752b7ddda2b69"]}]}
